entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The thrum of helicopter blades was..."
entries.dialogueText: The thrum of helicopter blades was almost deafening as we prepared for our descent into the Meftiem International Trade Zone.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I looked out the window. We were ab..."
entries.dialogueText: I looked out the window. We were above the Meftiem Basin, an expansive dried-up lake containing millions of years' worth of sedimentary deposits.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Smoke rose from the surrounding ref..."
entries.dialogueText: Smoke rose from the surrounding refineries, turning the sky a musty shade of orange.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We gently touched down on the helip..."
entries.dialogueText: We gently touched down on the helipad of the Cooperation Center, the building where MITZ board meetings and other diplomatic functions were held.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My eyes followed a cargo-laden frei..."
entries.dialogueText: My eyes followed a cargo-laden freight train as it departed the Meftiem station. Next to me in the helicopter, Elena noticed it as well.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We were immediately met by a large..."
entries.dialogueText: We were immediately met by a large security retinue and ushered inside to the reception hall, where the welcome ceremony was to take place.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Alma Saltana greeted us by the entr..."
entries.dialogueText: Alma Saltana greeted us by the entrance. A security staff member showed Elena to her seat, while I followed the Morellan prime minister to the front of the hall.

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""One of Lespia's, by the looks of i..."
entries.dialogueText: "One of Lespia's, by the looks of it. The gold will be shipped out of the Muardien Port and reach Veno Robin by this evening."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Lespia, eh? I hope Prime Minister..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lespia, eh? I hope Prime Minister Alvarez remembers I took his side at the AN."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A Lespian train? Do you think I ca..."
entries.dialogueText: "A Lespian train? Do you think I can spit on it from here?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Lespia doesn't need gold. Not now..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lespia doesn't need gold. Not now that it's about to have Palesian gas."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And from there, straight into Prim..."
entries.dialogueText: "And from there, straight into Prime Minister Alvarez's pocket."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The birthplace of Lespian Protecti..."
entries.dialogueText: "The birthplace of Lespian Protectionism, relying on international partnerships for gold imports. Tell me how that squares up."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""I'm sure he hasn't forgotten. But..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure he hasn't forgotten. But he will be expecting you to follow up on your words with action today."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Very funny, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Very funny, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""With one or two detours in between..."
entries.dialogueText: "With one or two detours in between. But yes, Alvarez has no small personal stake in the operations here."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""You're absolutely right, Your Maje..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're absolutely right, Your Majesty. Lespian economic theory does favor domestic production over foreign imports."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Our northern neighbors have a cert..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our northern neighbors have a certain standard of wealth to uphold. Especially as an ATO member."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Are you ready for today's meeting?..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you ready for today's meeting? I know neither of us wants Morella's nationalization plans to succeed."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""I recall you took a rather pro-Mor..."
entries.dialogueText: "I recall you took a rather pro-Morella stance at the Alliance of Nations session. Are you still leaning in that direction?"

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Thank you for coming, Mr. Toras.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for coming, Mr. Toras."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You shall address me as 'Your Maje..."
entries.dialogueText: "You shall address me as 'Your Majesty', Madam Prime Minister."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Of course, Comrade Saltana. I'm gr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, Comrade Saltana. I'm grateful for the chance to speak with you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Prime Minister Saltana. A pleasure..."
entries.dialogueText: "Prime Minister Saltana. A pleasure to see you again."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked bemused."
entries.dialogueText: She looked bemused.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She smiled politely."
entries.dialogueText: She smiled politely.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Excuse me, Your Majesty. We're no..."
entries.dialogueText: "Excuse me, Your Majesty. We're no longer used to such titles in this country."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I was gladdened to hear you were a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was gladdened to hear you were able to reach an understanding with Wehlen. It gives me hope for today's talks."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""And you. I hope you've been well s..."
entries.dialogueText: "And you. I hope you've been well since our encounter at the AN."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She smiled politely."
entries.dialogueText: She smiled politely.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I'll assume that is not an attempt..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll assume that is not an attempt to mock me."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I'd like to start straight away, b..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'd like to start straight away, but my advisors have persuaded me that diplomatic protocol must be followed."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She gestured for me to follow her."
entries.dialogueText: She gestured for me to follow her.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A stage had been set up backdropped..."
entries.dialogueText: A stage had been set up backdropped by our countries' four flags. Patricio Alvarez was already sitting there, looking somewhat bored.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I took my place next to him. He did..."
entries.dialogueText: I took my place next to him. He didn't acknowledge me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I took my place next to him. He gav..."
entries.dialogueText: I took my place next to him. He gave me a nod of acknowledgement.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good afternoon, Mr. Prime Minister.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good afternoon, Mr. Prime Minister."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How was your ride here?""
entries.dialogueText: "How was your ride here?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good afternoon, Mr. Prime Minister.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good afternoon, Mr. Prime Minister."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How was your ride here?""
entries.dialogueText: "How was your ride here?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I didn't acknowledge him either."
entries.dialogueText: I didn't acknowledge him either.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I nodded back at him."
entries.dialogueText: I nodded back at him.

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""It had better be a good afternoon,..."
entries.dialogueText: "It had better be a good afternoon, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Greetings, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Greetings, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""It was fine, Your Majesty. Thank y..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was fine, Your Majesty. Thank you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We both fell silent."
entries.dialogueText: We both fell silent.

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Not bad. We had to take a motorcad..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not bad. We had to take a motorcade from Stadelle. Can you believe there's nowhere to land a private jet around here?"

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Good to see you, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good to see you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The doors to the hall suddenly swun..."
entries.dialogueText: The doors to the hall suddenly swung open. Emmerich Hegel entered, accompanied by a pair of bodyguards.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The hall began to fill up with dign..."
entries.dialogueText: The hall began to fill up with dignitaries, ministers and heads of corporations.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Alvarez glanced around, then reache..."
entries.dialogueText: Alvarez glanced around, then reached into his pocket and pulled out a flask. He took a furtive sip and offered it to me.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't drink. I thought you didn'..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't drink. I thought you didn't either."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I thought you didn't drink.""
entries.dialogueText: "I thought you didn't drink."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sure, why not?""
entries.dialogueText: "Sure, why not?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What happened to your 'social club..."
entries.dialogueText: "What happened to your 'social club'?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I noticed a certain bleariness in h..."
entries.dialogueText: I noticed a certain bleariness in his eyes. I wondered whether his decision to quit drinking had lasted.

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""We've got a long meeting ahead of..."
entries.dialogueText: "We've got a long meeting ahead of us. Got to take the edge off somehow."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""The stress of this job gets to a m..."
entries.dialogueText: "The stress of this job gets to a man. I'm impressed you've managed to hold out."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Yes, well, the stress of this job..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, well, the stress of this job gets to a man. There was only so long I could hold out."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""They don't understand the stress o..."
entries.dialogueText: "They don't understand the stress of this job. Hardly anyone does."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I understand. Give it here.""
entries.dialogueText: "I understand. Give it here."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll leave you to it. I'd rather s..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll leave you to it. I'd rather stay sharp for today's meeting."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He stuffed the flask back into his..."
entries.dialogueText: He stuffed the flask back into his pocket as the hall began to fill with dignitaries, ministers and executives.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He passed me the flask and I took a..."
entries.dialogueText: He passed me the flask and I took a quick sip. He stuffed it back in his pocket as the hall began to fill with dignitaries, ministers and executives.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He gave me a reproachful look as he..."
entries.dialogueText: He gave me a reproachful look as he stuffed the flask back in his pocket. The hall began to fill with dignitaries, ministers and executives.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rusty Montoro was in the back row,..."
entries.dialogueText: Rusty Montoro was in the back row, talking animatedly to a Lespian politician. He didn't so much as glance in my direction.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rusty Montoro was in the back row,..."
entries.dialogueText: Rusty Montoro was in the back row, talking animatedly to a Lespian politician. He broke off his conversation to throw me a smile.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He and Prime Minister Saltana excha..."
entries.dialogueText: He and Prime Minister Saltana exchanged cheek kisses. Alvarez could barely disguise his look of scorn.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Saltana and Hegel joined us on stag..."
entries.dialogueText: Saltana and Hegel joined us on stage. The Valgslandian chancellor shook my hand with an enigmatic smile.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Saltana and Hegel joined us on stag..."
entries.dialogueText: Saltana and Hegel joined us on stage. The Valgslandian chancellor shook my hand with an encouraging smile.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Saltana and Hegel joined us on stag..."
entries.dialogueText: Saltana and Hegel joined us on stage. The Valgslandian chancellor frowned sternly as he shook my hand.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The four of us posed for photograph..."
entries.dialogueText: The four of us posed for photographs. The Morellan national anthem was played, then those of Valgsland, Rizia and finally Lespia.

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Hmm. That shows who takes what pri..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hmm. That shows who takes what priority, doesn't it?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good to see you, Chancellor. Actua..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good to see you, Chancellor. Actually, I was hoping we could speak in private later."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""That very much depends, Mr. Toras.""
entries.dialogueText: "That very much depends, Mr. Toras."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good that you made it. It's time w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good that you made it. It's time we settled this silly debate."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I nodded at him."
entries.dialogueText: I nodded at him.

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""It is not silly, Mr. Toras. Lives..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is not silly, Mr. Toras. Lives and livelihoods rest on our decisions today."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "When the music died down, we were e..."
entries.dialogueText: When the music died down, we were escorted to a conference room together with our key ministers, security detail and a number of legal advisors.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Once we were seated, Prime Minister..."
entries.dialogueText: Once we were seated, Prime Minister Saltana spoke.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Thank you for carving time out of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for carving time out of your schedules to join me today, gentlemen."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked around the table at each..."
entries.dialogueText: She looked around the table at each of us.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Over 35 years ago, our countries s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Over 35 years ago, our countries signed an agreement regarding the sharing of resources in the Meftiem basin."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""At that time, Morella was capable..."
entries.dialogueText: "At that time, Morella was capable neither of exploring the full potential of the gold located here, nor of fending off raids from our Derdian neighbors."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""It was only with the cooperation o..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was only with the cooperation of Rizia, Valgsland and Lespia that the Meftiem International Trade Zone could become the thriving industrial center it is today."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""However, our predecessors failed t..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, our predecessors failed to recognize the social and moral responsibility that comes with such an economic endeavor. And Morella paid the price."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What are you smiling about, Chance..."
entries.dialogueText: "What are you smiling about, Chancellor?"

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Oh, just the chance to make histor..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, just the chance to make history today."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I still want to know why Valgsland..."
entries.dialogueText: "I still want to know why Valgsland is only supporting nationalization now. Why didn't you hand your ITZ stake back to Morella right after the revolution?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As a supporter of the 'Save the Ar..."
entries.dialogueText: "As a supporter of the 'Save the Arufelde' initiative, I want to know how your nationalization plan will tackle the pollution issue."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Of course, {RiziaDLCText.SaltanaTo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, {RiziaDLCText.SaltanaToPlayer}."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Toxic chemicals continue to leach..."
entries.dialogueText: "Toxic chemicals continue to leach into the river's watershed, and are slowly poisoning the surrounding communities."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I might add that the river empties..."
entries.dialogueText: "I might add that the river empties into the gulf of Moridia, which is bordered by Rizia, Derdia and Wehlen as well as my country."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Jump to: [ITZ Nationalization Qs For Board]

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""The CSP has no involvement in what..."
entries.dialogueText: "The CSP has no involvement in what is happening here. Ms. Saltana is merely standing up for the rights of her own countrymen and women."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Is she? Then let me hear it from h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Is she? Then let me hear it from her own mouth. Ms. Saltana, can you confirm you have no interest in joining the Contanan Security Pact?"

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Our struggle for control of the MI..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our struggle for control of the MITZ is connected with the worldwide struggle against a system that prioritizes capital gains over human welfare. That's all I will say."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Well, Lespia stands firm in our co..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, Lespia stands firm in our conviction that the ownership of the MITZ should not change."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""And I suspect His Majesty King Rom..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I suspect His Majesty King Romus feels the same way."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""If His Majesty knows what's good f..."
entries.dialogueText: "If His Majesty knows what's good for his kingdom, he'll agree with me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Everyone seated at the table turned..."
entries.dialogueText: Everyone seated at the table turned to look at me. Elena cleared her throat.

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Are you ready for the vote, Your M..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you ready for the vote, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No, I have a few more questions fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, I have a few more questions for the board."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Alvarez eyed me incredulously."
entries.dialogueText: Alvarez eyed me incredulously.

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""You're still on the fence? I remem..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're still on the fence? I remember you made your position very clear to me."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I don't wish you to take this deci..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't wish you to take this decision lightly, {RiziaDLCText.SaltanaToPlayer}. What else do you want to know?"

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Jump to: [ITZ Nationalization Qs For Board]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Actually, Ms. Werner, I would like..."
entries.dialogueText: "Actually, Ms. Werner, I would like to confer with you privately before making my final decision."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Alvarez eyed me incredulously."
entries.dialogueText: Alvarez eyed me incredulously.

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""You're still on the fence? I remem..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're still on the fence? I remember you made your position very clear to me."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Absolutely, {RiziaDLCText.SaltanaT..."
entries.dialogueText: "Absolutely, {RiziaDLCText.SaltanaToPlayer}. Take all the time you need."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Jump to: [ITZ Nationalization Qs For Elena]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I was born ready, Ms. Werner.""
entries.dialogueText: "I was born ready, Ms. Werner."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Of course I would, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course I would, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""I would just like to point out wha..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would just like to point out what a towering achievement it is that the MITZ exists in the first place."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Four countries with four vastly di..."
entries.dialogueText: "Four countries with four vastly different governments, coming together for the economic benefit of all? It sounds preposterous, yet it works."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""The cooperation -- and yes, compet..."
entries.dialogueText: "The cooperation -- and yes, competition -- involved in sharing this valuable resource has not only brought our nations closer together, it's spurred innovation far beyond what any of us could achieve individually."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""We could harness that same spirit..."
entries.dialogueText: "We could harness that same spirit to address the very valid concerns Ms. Saltana has brought up about the environment and human rights."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He shrugged."
entries.dialogueText: He shrugged.

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Or we could throw all of that away..."
entries.dialogueText: "Or we could throw all of that away, scare off investors and put God knows how many people out of work, because... why exactly? To score a few points with our eastern comrades?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Saltana and Hegel both had icy star..."
entries.dialogueText: Saltana and Hegel both had icy stares on their faces.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked defiant."
entries.dialogueText: She looked defiant.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""In the case of a split decision, w..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the case of a split decision, we would have to renegotiate the initial MITZ agreement until a way forward is found."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""But Morella will no longer accept..."
entries.dialogueText: "But Morella will no longer accept the status quo."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Nor will Valgsland.""
entries.dialogueText: "Nor will Valgsland."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As the King of Rizia, I vote in fa..."
entries.dialogueText: "As the King of Rizia, I vote in favor of nationalization. The International Trade Zone should be under Morellan ownership."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I vote against nationalization. Ho..."
entries.dialogueText: "I vote against nationalization. However, I am open to renegotiating our original agreement to recognize the contributions and sacrifices made by the nation of Morella."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The International Trade Zone shoul..."
entries.dialogueText: "The International Trade Zone should not be nationalized. Furthermore, I do not believe our resource and profit sharing agreement should be changed in any way."

entries.dialogueText: "All right. I'm ready to move forward with my decision."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Very good, {RiziaDLCText.SaltanaTo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very good, {RiziaDLCText.SaltanaToPlayer}."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""And by 'move forward', you mean...""
entries.dialogueText: "And by 'move forward', you mean..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have made up my mind.""
entries.dialogueText: "I have made up my mind."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Then let's proceed with the vote.""
entries.dialogueText: "Then let's proceed with the vote."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I would still like to confer with..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would still like to confer with my treasurer before casting my official vote."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I understand.""
entries.dialogueText: "I understand."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Alvarez sighed audibly. Prime Minis..."
entries.dialogueText: Alvarez sighed audibly. Prime Minister Saltana nodded.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The others at the table glanced aro..."
entries.dialogueText: The others at the table glanced around impatiently. Prime Minister Saltana nodded.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The group dispersed. Elena and I we..."
entries.dialogueText: The group dispersed. Elena and I were seated in a smaller private conference room.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""We'll set up a separate room for y..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll set up a separate room for you. The rest of us can break for coffee."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Of course. He owns the majority of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course. He owns the majority of Rizian Royal Gold, after all."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Before we continue, Your Majesty...""
entries.dialogueText: "Before we continue, Your Majesty..."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""I do think Mr. Montoro should be p..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do think Mr. Montoro should be privy to this conversation as well."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't see why. The Rizian govern..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't see why. The Rizian government is the primary operator in the MITZ, not him."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, good idea. This decision does..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, good idea. This decision does greatly affect his company."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't see the need. Don't we alr..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't see the need. Don't we already know what he's going to say?"

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Well, yes. But he certainly wouldn..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, yes. But he certainly wouldn't appreciate being left out of this discussion."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Well, yes, but we operate using eq..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, yes, but we operate using equipment and contractors from RRG. Nationalization would affect them greatly."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""We do operate our part of the MITZ..."
entries.dialogueText: "We do operate our part of the MITZ using equipment and contractors from Rizian Royal Gold, after all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Fine. Let's bring him in.""
entries.dialogueText: "Fine. Let's bring him in."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We can talk to him later. For now,..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can talk to him later. For now, I don't want him influencing my decision."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Elena notified an aide to send for..."
entries.dialogueText: Elena notified an aide to send for Rusty. A few minutes later, he appeared.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Elena nodded reluctantly."
entries.dialogueText: Elena nodded reluctantly.

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Very well. I suspect we'll be hear..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very well. I suspect we'll be hearing from him about this."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Your Majesty. Elena. Have you trie..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty. Elena. Have you tried Morellan sukhar biscuits yet? They're drier than a letter from my ex-wife's divorce attorney."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""We are here to talk about biscuits..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are here to talk about biscuits, aren't we? Because as far as I'm concerned, the nationalization debate doesn't merit a discussion."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Elena raised an eyebrow."
entries.dialogueText: Elena raised an eyebrow.

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""King Romus here is the leader of o..."
entries.dialogueText: "King Romus here is the leader of our country. If he says a discussion is necessary, then it is."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Oh. My sincerest apologies to you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh. My sincerest apologies to you both. I was just joking."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't like the idea of nationali..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't like the idea of nationalization either. But I want my decision to be fully informed."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Well, I am not laughing. Consider..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, I am not laughing. Consider yourself lucky to even be in this room right now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're right, though. Those biscui..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're right, though. Those biscuits are drier than Ms. Werner's financial reports."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rusty let out a laugh. Elena clicke..."
entries.dialogueText: Rusty let out a laugh. Elena clicked her tongue disapprovingly.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Elena nodded in agreement, then gla..."
entries.dialogueText: Elena nodded in agreement, then glanced up at the clock.

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""We don't have long. Where would yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "We don't have long. Where would you like to begin, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What will be the economic and fina..."
entries.dialogueText: "What will be the economic and financial impact on Rizia if Morella goes through with the nationalization plan?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What was Rizian Royal Gold's role..."
entries.dialogueText: "What was Rizian Royal Gold's role in the labor and environmental violations that have occurred in the MITZ?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Is there any scenario where we can..."
entries.dialogueText: "Is there any scenario where we can *increase* our MITZ stake? Say, by renegotiating the profit sharing agreement in our favor?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rusty's mouth dropped open."
entries.dialogueText: Rusty's mouth dropped open.

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""But by privately negotiating the p..."
entries.dialogueText: "But by privately negotiating the proposal terms with Prime Minister Saltana, we may yet be able to make an arrangement where we come out relatively unscathed."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""That depends on the exact nature o..."
entries.dialogueText: "That depends on the exact nature of the agreement, doesn't it?"

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""That'd be a real risk, Your Majest..."
entries.dialogueText: "That'd be a real risk, Your Majesty. RRG already almost went belly-up after we lost Zille."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""If we cannot do that, we run the r..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we cannot do that, we run the risk of losing a significant income source."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Add to that the cost of implementi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Add to that the cost of implementing those new regulations you ordered and, well, nationalization could be a killing blow."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""And the new regulations you ordere..."
entries.dialogueText: "And the new regulations you ordered were quite costly to implement, though I remain convinced they were worth it."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""At the same time, we are facing hi..."
entries.dialogueText: "At the same time, we are facing high gold demand from Rumburg and, soon, Wehlen."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""At the same time, we are facing th..."
entries.dialogueText: "At the same time, we are facing the usual high gold demand from Rumburg."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""We have our new gas holdings to fa..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have our new gas holdings to fall back on, as long as Duke Reinhart does not renege on his end of the agreement."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""With little in the way of gas hold..."
entries.dialogueText: "With little in the way of gas holdings, it would be difficult for Rizia to carry on as a resource-based economy."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Thanks to you, we didn't have to w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks to you, we didn't have to waste money on needless safely regulations. But still, nationalization could be a killing blow."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Your rejection of the RPP's safety..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your rejection of the RPP's safety proposal helped keep the status quo, but nationalization would definitely be a big blow."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I see. Good that we have the gas a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I see. Good that we have the gas as a safety net."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I didn't know the situation was th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I didn't know the situation was this grave."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Maybe that's for the best. Both of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Maybe that's for the best. Both of those resources would deplete eventually anyway."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It won't come to that. We're keepi..."
entries.dialogueText: "It won't come to that. We're keeping our gold share no matter what."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""The agreement is still being delib..."
entries.dialogueText: "The agreement is still being deliberated on. We really should solidify it."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""It's not grave yet. But we should..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's not grave yet. But we should refrain from making rash promises."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""If that's your primary goal, then..."
entries.dialogueText: "If that's your primary goal, then we shouldn't vote for nationalization."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Yes, I have always thought it wise..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, I have always thought it wise not to rely so much on either."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""We have our new gas holdings to fa..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have our new gas holdings to fall back on, as long as Mr. Alvarez does not renege on his end of the agreement."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Such a scenario isn't impossible,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Such a scenario isn't impossible, but it will be difficult."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Ha! I like the way you're thinking.""
entries.dialogueText: "Ha! I like the way you're thinking."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Morella will demand a larger profi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Morella will demand a larger profit share if the board votes against nationalization. Not without reason."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""With Hegel and Saltana presenting..."
entries.dialogueText: "With Hegel and Saltana presenting a united front, it will likely come down to Rizia versus Lespia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Or we push back together.""
entries.dialogueText: "Or we push back together."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's a zero-sum game. Morella's st..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's a zero-sum game. Morella's stake can't grow unless one of ours shrinks."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Or you present Morella with someth..."
entries.dialogueText: "Or you present Morella with something better than a larger stake."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""At least Saltana seems to hate Alv..."
entries.dialogueText: "At least Saltana seems to hate Alvarez."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Don't underestimate Lespia's wealt..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't underestimate Lespia's wealth. If the Prime Minister presents a good enough deal, hate will fall by the wayside."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""That would be in line with your in..."
entries.dialogueText: "That would be in line with your intention to position Rizia closer to ATO."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""That would put us further from our..."
entries.dialogueText: "That would put us further from our goal of improving relations with our non-ATO neighbors."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""At the expense of our relations wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "At the expense of our relations with Morella, of course."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""In addition to the MITZ, Morella a..."
entries.dialogueText: "In addition to the MITZ, Morella and Rizia share a long border. I would prefer we find a compromise to preserve our relations with our neighbor."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""I am all for finding a compromise..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am all for finding a compromise in order to preserve our relations with our neighbor."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""The question is whether we will be..."
entries.dialogueText: "The question is whether we will be able to offer Morella something that Lespia cannot."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""'Violations' is what they're sayin..."
entries.dialogueText: "'Violations' is what they're saying?'"

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""First of all, I will remind you th..."
entries.dialogueText: "First of all, I will remind you that Rizian Royal Gold never made our own decisions in the MITZ. We only acted on behalf of whoever wore the crown."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""All we ever did was follow the rul..."
entries.dialogueText: "All we ever did was follow the rules. What incentive would we possibly have had for going above and beyond?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So the Rizian government engaged i..."
entries.dialogueText: "So the Rizian government engaged in worker exploitation and toxic waste dumping simply because it was allowed to."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Because Lespia and Morella were do..."
entries.dialogueText: "Because Lespia and Morella were doing it too. And Valgsland, for many more years than Comrade Hegel is willing to admit."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Might I remind you that if Rizia h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Might I remind you that if Rizia hadn't been able to keep our gold prices competitive, Rumburg would never have reached out to us about an alliance."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""What I mean to say is, you're welc..."
entries.dialogueText: "What I mean to say is, you're welcome, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Elena looked appalled."
entries.dialogueText: Elena looked appalled.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Ms. Werner, you advised my father...."
entries.dialogueText: "Ms. Werner, you advised my father. Did you never once speak to him about this?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am sorry for what your people ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am sorry for what your people have gone through."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Any plan, for nationalization or o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Any plan, for nationalization or otherwise, must address this."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Yes, I agree.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, I agree."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""The time for apologies is long pas..."
entries.dialogueText: "The time for apologies is long past, Your Majesty. The time for action has arrived."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But who allowed for the runoff to..."
entries.dialogueText: "But who allowed for the runoff to happen in the first place, Ms. Saltana? The board could have implemented better regulations from the start."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How do you know the damage you spe..."
entries.dialogueText: "How do you know the damage you speak of is tied to the mines? Anything could have contaminated that river."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She sighed regretfully."
entries.dialogueText: She sighed regretfully.

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""In the meantime, what did you stil..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the meantime, what did you still want to know regarding the nationalization debate?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Elena's face turned taut."
entries.dialogueText: Elena's face turned taut.

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Technically speaking, Your Majesty..."
entries.dialogueText: "Technically speaking, Your Majesty, there were no violations. RRG acted according to the regulations agreed on by all four MITZ partners."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Furthermore, they're merely contra..."
entries.dialogueText: "Furthermore, they're merely contractors here. They've been acting on behalf of the Crown this entire time."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Elena's face went taut."
entries.dialogueText: Elena's face went taut.

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""It was a hard time for Rizia's eco..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was a hard time for Rizia's economy. We were under pressure to keep gold prices competitive, especially after the uprising."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In other words, if more stringent..."
entries.dialogueText: "In other words, if more stringent regulations were placed on the MITZ, RRG would follow those?"

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""The economy never would've recover..."
entries.dialogueText: "The economy never would've recovered from '26, the populace would still be sore at the monarchy and the dearly departed Princess Lena would never have laid a hand on your royal scepter."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't worry. I am not blaming you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry. I am not blaming you."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""For Dast's sake, Rusty, be more re..."
entries.dialogueText: "For Dast's sake, Rusty, be more respectful to your king."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Prime Minister Saltana's predecess..."
entries.dialogueText: "Prime Minister Saltana's predecessors agreed to keep regulations lax in the MITZ to attract investment. All four partners took advantage of that, Morella and Valgsland included."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Ms. Werner, you advised my father...."
entries.dialogueText: "Ms. Werner, you advised my father. Did you never once speak to him about this?"

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""I tried. But, well...""
entries.dialogueText: "I tried. But, well..."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""It was a hard time for Rizia's eco..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was a hard time for Rizia's economy. We were under pressure to keep gold prices low, especially after the uprising."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Prime Minister Saltana's predecess..."
entries.dialogueText: "Prime Minister Saltana's predecessors agreed to keep regulations lax in the MITZ to attract investment. All four partners took advantage of that, Morella and Valgsland included."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""They would have to, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "They would have to, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""We'd have to secure compliance fro..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'd have to secure compliance from all four partners. Otherwise, one of them -- say, Lespia -- might gain an unfair advantage."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So the Rizian government engaged i..."
entries.dialogueText: "So the Rizian government engaged in worker exploitation and toxic waste dumping simply because they were allowed to."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Because everyone else was doing th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Because everyone else was doing the same. Including Morella and Valgsland."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""If your father's regime had volunt..."
entries.dialogueText: "If your father's regime had voluntarily cracked down on those practices, our gold prices would have skyrocketed. The Rumburg alliance would be nothing more than a pipe dream."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Government greed fuelling corporat..."
entries.dialogueText: "Government greed fuelling corporate greed."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It makes me sick that my own house..."
entries.dialogueText: "It makes me sick that my own house was complicit in this."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""My predecessors intentionally kept..."
entries.dialogueText: "My predecessors intentionally kept ITZ regulations lax to attract investment. They were willing to overlook the consequences as long as they kept turning a profit."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""But no more.""
entries.dialogueText: "But no more."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But you would not be willing to de..."
entries.dialogueText: "But you would not be willing to decrease Lespia's profit share."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He sat up straight."
entries.dialogueText: He sat up straight.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You are doing Morella a disservice..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are doing Morella a disservice by resorting to such a gross oversimplification."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A nice thought. But I have a hunch..."
entries.dialogueText: "A nice thought. But I have a hunch that as long as Lespia keeps its stake in the MITZ, sustainability will always come second to profit."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You see, Mr. Hegel and Ms. Saltana..."
entries.dialogueText: "You see, Mr. Hegel and Ms. Saltana? Ideological differences shouldn't keep us from preserving what we've created."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Exactly. All of us care about impr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Exactly. All of us care about improving conditions here."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Why are you pointing the finger at..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why are you pointing the finger at Lespia? Our share is no larger than yours."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""But not an inaccurate one, right,..."
entries.dialogueText: "But not an inaccurate one, right, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""I am willing to dedicate time and..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am willing to dedicate time and resources to improve conditions in the MITZ. Isn't that enough?"

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Was your donation a mere token ges..."
entries.dialogueText: "Was your donation a mere token gesture, then?"

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""For your information, the sulphate..."
entries.dialogueText: "For your information, the sulphate and heavy metal levels found in the river could only be a result of mining."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Mr. Toras, if you meant what you s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Toras, if you meant what you said at the AN, you shouldn't even be entertaining this opinion."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Saltana glanced at him uncomfortabl..."
entries.dialogueText: Saltana glanced at him uncomfortably.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Whatever is decided today, I am wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Whatever is decided today, I am willing to work with both Rizia and Lespia. Our differing outlooks shouldn't get in the way of a peaceful compromise."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The past decades of industrial acti..."
entries.dialogueText: The past decades of industrial activity had turned it into a mosaic of underground and open-pit mines linked by roads, railways and makeshift canals.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I turned to look at Alvarez. His ey..."
entries.dialogueText: I turned to look at Alvarez. His eyes were shooting daggers into me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hegel applauded solemnly."
entries.dialogueText: Hegel applauded solemnly.

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""A wise choice, Mr. Toras. History..."
entries.dialogueText: "A wise choice, Mr. Toras. History will reward you for it."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I am as surprised as I am grateful..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am as surprised as I am grateful, {RiziaDLCText.SaltanaToPlayer}. I look forward to collaborating with you on a fair proposal."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""That's your decision, Your Majesty?""
entries.dialogueText: "That's your decision, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I turned to look at Alvarez. He had..."
entries.dialogueText: I turned to look at Alvarez. He had an artificial smile on his face.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He looked at the other two leaders..."
entries.dialogueText: He looked at the other two leaders at the table.

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Let the record show that the King..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let the record show that the King of Rizia cannot be trusted to keep a promise."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""I know when I've been defeated.""
entries.dialogueText: "I know when I've been defeated."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""You can count on my cooperation. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "You can count on my cooperation. I am absolutely brimming with suggestions."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hegel glared at me."
entries.dialogueText: Hegel glared at me.

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""So your words at the AN were merel..."
entries.dialogueText: "So your words at the AN were merely for show."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""I did not expect anything else fro..."
entries.dialogueText: "I did not expect anything else from you, Mr. Toras."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Fortunately, there are some in you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fortunately, there are some in your country who have compassion for the downtrodden. And there will be more."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""A monarch will never have compassi..."
entries.dialogueText: "A monarch will never have compassion for the downtrodden. It's not in his nature."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Take heart, Comrade Hegel. If the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Take heart, Comrade Hegel. If the King of Rizia is truly willing to build a fairer and more sustainable ITZ with us, then today was not a total loss."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Take heart, Comrade Hegel. I'm sur..."
entries.dialogueText: "Take heart, Comrade Hegel. I'm sure that both Rizia and Lespia will join us at the negotiating table in due time."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I turned to look at Alvarez. He had..."
entries.dialogueText: I turned to look at Alvarez. He had a plastic smile on his face.

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Yes, I too am willing to work on a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, I too am willing to work on a new ITZ agreement that takes into account the complaints Prime Minister Saltana has made today."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""We can all be proud of what we hav..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can all be proud of what we have accomplished in this room today."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I turned to look at Alvarez. He had..."
entries.dialogueText: I turned to look at Alvarez. He had a plastic smile on his face.

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""I am with King Romus. We will buil..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am with King Romus. We will build a more equitable ITZ through friendly cooperation, not profit-snatching."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's to be expected. I understan..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's to be expected. I understand completely."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Or nudged into compliance by gover..."
entries.dialogueText: "Or nudged into compliance by governments and shareholders."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""If that had not been the case, you..."
entries.dialogueText: "If that had not been the case, your father would have been deposed. Or worse."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We forced corporations to treat th..."
entries.dialogueText: "We forced corporations to treat their workers better in Rizia. We can do the same here."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""The MITZ is a much more complicate..."
entries.dialogueText: "The MITZ is a much more complicated ecosystem, Your Majesty. But yes, it should be possible."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""I wouldn't call it greed, Your Maj..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wouldn't call it greed, Your Majesty. More like survival."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But if more stringent regulations..."
entries.dialogueText: "But if more stringent regulations were placed on the MITZ, your company would follow those?"

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Naturally. We're not criminals.""
entries.dialogueText: "Naturally. We're not criminals."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Of course, the other MITZ partners..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, the other MITZ partners would have to agree to the same thing. We can't have one of them gaining an unfair advantage over us."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Think about it, Your Majesty. If i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Think about it, Your Majesty. If it hadn't been for the MITZ, the economy never would've recovered from '26, the populace would still be sore at the monarchy and the dearly departed Princess Lena would never have laid a hand on your royal scepter."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I recall you made the same case ag..."
entries.dialogueText: "I recall you made the same case against safety regulations in Rizia. I didn't buy it then, and I don't now."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Oh, we did lose a pretty penny fro..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, we did lose a pretty penny from those regulations. But we just about balanced it out with royalties from the mines here. If we lose that, well... don't blame me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My councilor is right. The Crown's..."
entries.dialogueText: "My councilor is right. The Crown's debts to RRG do not give you license to besmirch the memory of my wife. Apologize now."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rusty's face assumed an abashed exp..."
entries.dialogueText: Rusty's face assumed an abashed expression.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Truly sorry, Your Majesty. No more..."
entries.dialogueText: "Truly sorry, Your Majesty. No more besmirching."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My father made the right decision..."
entries.dialogueText: "My father made the right decision at the time. But something has to change."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""I agree. And this is an opportunit..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree. And this is an opportunity to change four countries' policies in one."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Saltana looked puzzled for a moment..."
entries.dialogueText: Saltana looked puzzled for a moment, but shook it off.

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""I'm sure you are.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure you are."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""We should inform our guests of the..."
entries.dialogueText: "We should inform our guests of the good news. Let's get back to the reception hall."

entries.dialogueText: "No questions, really. I just wanted to keep everyone out there waiting a bit longer."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: Rusty burst out laughing.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Nice move! Should we play cards?""
entries.dialogueText: "Nice move! Should we play cards?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Elena clicked her tongue."
entries.dialogueText: Elena clicked her tongue.

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""A power play. I see.""
entries.dialogueText: "A power play. I see."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""I think we've made our point. Let'..."
entries.dialogueText: "I think we've made our point. Let's reconvene with the others."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Elena clicked her tongue."
entries.dialogueText: Elena clicked her tongue.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""All right.""
entries.dialogueText: "All right."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""You know what to do, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "You know what to do, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Good luck with the vote, Your Maje..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good luck with the vote, Your Majesty."

entries.title: Narrator: "He locked eyes with me."
entries.dialogueText: He locked eyes with me.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That was everything I wanted to ta..."
entries.dialogueText: "That was everything I wanted to talk about."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""You're sure about that, Your Majes..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're sure about that, Your Majesty? I'm very happy to talk more about the long-term negative impact of nationalization."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Elena nodded briskly."
entries.dialogueText: Elena nodded briskly.

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Very good, Your Majesty. Let's rec..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very good, Your Majesty. Let's reconvene with the others."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Elena shook her head."
entries.dialogueText: Elena shook her head.

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""No, we've taken enough time here...."
entries.dialogueText: "No, we've taken enough time here. We should reconvene with the others."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He motioned for the guards to escor..."
entries.dialogueText: He motioned for the guards to escort him out to the reception hall.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We headed back to the conference ro..."
entries.dialogueText: We headed back to the conference room and settled back into our seats.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am ready to proceed with the vot..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am ready to proceed with the vote."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I'm happy to hear that.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm happy to hear that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Actually, *now* I have a few quest..."
entries.dialogueText: "Actually, *now* I have a few questions for the board."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Alvarez quietly groaned in frustrat..."
entries.dialogueText: Alvarez quietly groaned in frustration. Saltana bowed her head.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""By all means, {RiziaDLCText.Saltan..."
entries.dialogueText: "By all means, {RiziaDLCText.SaltanaToPlayer}."
