entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Saltana rose from her seat energeti..."
entries.dialogueText: Saltana rose from her seat energetically.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Rizian, Valgslandian and Lespia..."
entries.dialogueText: The Rizian, Valgslandian and Lespian delegations slowly began filing out of the conference room. Next to me, Elena spoke under her breath.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As Alvarez and I stood up, I saw hi..."
entries.dialogueText: As Alvarez and I stood up, I saw him take another sip from his flask. He noticed my gaze and nodded slightly.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""We should inform our guests of the..."
entries.dialogueText: "We should inform our guests of the decision. Let's get back to the reception hall."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""So it's you and me against the Mal..."
entries.dialogueText: "So it's you and me against the Malenyevists."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""So you sided with the Malenyevists..."
entries.dialogueText: "So you sided with the Malenyevists in the end."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""So we're making deals with the Mal..."
entries.dialogueText: "So we're making deals with the Malenyevists now."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He stepped past me and out the door..."
entries.dialogueText: He stepped past me and out the door.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We hit a rough patch of air as we c..."
entries.dialogueText: We hit a rough patch of air as we continued our descent. I felt the gold disc in my suit pocket bump against my side.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""By the way, didn't you mention bac..."
entries.dialogueText: "By the way, didn't you mention back in Qalus that you were an expert on antique coins?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I stayed silent."
entries.dialogueText: I stayed silent.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rusty had mentioned that it had bee..."
entries.dialogueText: Rusty had mentioned that it had been found here in the MITZ. I wondered what its significance was.

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Why, yes. You remember more about..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why, yes. You remember more about that night than I do, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She adjusted her hair with a proud..."
entries.dialogueText: She adjusted her hair with a proud smile.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I showed her the disc Rusty had giv..."
entries.dialogueText: I showed her the disc Rusty had given me. Her eyes widened in glee.

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""That's no coin, Your Majesty. It's..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's no coin, Your Majesty. It's a Rezenid-era Wruhecist prayer medallion."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""It was originally worn around one'..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was originally worn around one's neck, with the intention of keeping St. Wruhec's teachings close to your heart at all times."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sounds like it could also be helpf..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sounds like it could also be helpful in warding off an assassination attempt."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How much do you think it's worth?""
entries.dialogueText: "How much do you think it's worth?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I see. More proof that the Lord ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "I see. More proof that the Lord has chosen me to rule."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""I wouldn't rely on an assassin to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wouldn't rely on an assassin to be such a good marksman to hit that thing."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""It could be thousands. It's very o..."
entries.dialogueText: "It could be thousands. It's very old and very rare."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""One could see it that way, Your Ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "One could see it that way, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Who'd wear one of these when they..."
entries.dialogueText: "Who'd wear one of these when they could spend it?"

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""There are things more valuable tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "There are things more valuable than gold. Not many, but a few."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sorry to leave you in the lurch, M..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry to leave you in the lurch, Mr. Prime Minister."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I did. Do you have a problem with..."
entries.dialogueText: "I did. Do you have a problem with it?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Are you surprised? I made my inten..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you surprised? I made my intentions clear."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I didn't vote for nationalization...."
entries.dialogueText: "I didn't vote for nationalization. I held up my end of our bargain."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're outnumbered, Mr. Prime Mini..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're outnumbered, Mr. Prime Minister."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I held up my end of the bargain, d..."
entries.dialogueText: "I held up my end of the bargain, didn't I?"

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""You did, Your Majesty. But the rea..."
entries.dialogueText: "You did, Your Majesty. But the real bargaining hasn't even started yet."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm telling you, I will not give u..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm telling you, I will not give up a single cent."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Nor will I, Your Majesty. Safety i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nor will I, Your Majesty. Safety in numbers."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's the only way forward that ben..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's the only way forward that benefits everyone."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Does it, Your Majesty?""
entries.dialogueText: "Does it, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This isn't just a fight for the MI..."
entries.dialogueText: "This isn't just a fight for the MITZ. It's a fight against the forces of evil."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""A little melodramatic, Your Majest..."
entries.dialogueText: "A little melodramatic, Your Majesty. But rest assured good will triumph."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""I'll tell you right away that I do..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll tell you right away that I don't intend to lose a damn cent."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No, we're not. I just told Hegel a..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, we're not. I just told Hegel and his puppet what they wanted to hear."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Good.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Because I'll tell you right away t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Because I'll tell you right away that I don't intend to lose a damn cent."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Their ideology doesn't have anythi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Their ideology doesn't have anything to do with it. I just want to keep my money."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""So do I, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "So do I, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""But they make an exception for res..."
entries.dialogueText: "But they make an exception for resources like gold and gas, especially when Lespian companies have a hand in their extraction."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Of course I am. Do you accuse the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course I am. Do you accuse the King of Rizia of waffling?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes. The Trade Zone is on Morellan..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. The Trade Zone is on Morellan land, so naturally Morella should have a greater say in its operations."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I want to respect Morella's wishes..."
entries.dialogueText: "I want to respect Morella's wishes. But we can't ignore the MITZ's great economic importance to our kingdom."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No, not since my talk with Preside..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, not since my talk with President Smolak. We cannot afford to lose any more of our gold."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Do not assume that, Ms. Werner. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do not assume that, Ms. Werner. I am approaching the talks with an open mind."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Morella's wishes carry weight. But..."
entries.dialogueText: "Morella's wishes carry weight. But we can't ignore the MITZ's great importance to our kingdom."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Indeed not. I am not about to let..."
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed not. I am not about to let the Malenyevists steamroll over our economic interests."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""An understatement, Ms. Werner. My..."
entries.dialogueText: "An understatement, Ms. Werner. My recent talk with President Smolak made it clear that we must protect our remaining gold reserves at all costs."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""No, we can't. I'm sure we can reac..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, we can't. I'm sure we can reach a compromise that doesn't result in a total loss for us."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Perhaps so, Your Majesty. At the s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps so, Your Majesty. At the same time, we cannot simply hand over our assets to Morella without suffering serious economic consequences."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""No, Your Majesty. Your resolve is..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, Your Majesty. Your resolve is unmatched."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""You're absolutely right. But we al..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're absolutely right. But we also can't completely ignore Morella's demands."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Of course, Your Majesty. No decisi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, Your Majesty. No decision should be made without listening to all sides."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Agreed. As valid as Morella's conc..."
entries.dialogueText: "Agreed. As valid as Morella's concerns may be, their new ideology should not get in the way of our business agreement."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""We should listen to Morella's conc..."
entries.dialogueText: "We should listen to Morella's concerns, of course. But no, we cannot simply hand over our assets on a platter."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I was sorry to hear you were unabl..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was sorry to hear you were unable to reach an agreement with Wehlen. I'm confident today's talks will go more smoothly."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If you are as open to negotiation..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you are as open to negotiation as President Smolak was, I don't foresee a problem."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We haven't solidified our agreemen..."
entries.dialogueText: "We haven't solidified our agreement yet. In fact, it would be very helpful to have the international community on our side right now."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Likewise, {RiziaDLCText.SaltanaToP..."
entries.dialogueText: "Likewise, {RiziaDLCText.SaltanaToPlayer}."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you, Prime Minister Saltana...."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Prime Minister Saltana. The support of the international community means a lot to us at this time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As you see, my kingdom is not desp..."
entries.dialogueText: "As you see, my kingdom is not desperate. I will reject any so-called solution that does not benefit the Rizian people."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I hope you'll understand that I am..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope you'll understand that I am not able to offer my public support. Not yet, at least."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I assure you that I am.""
entries.dialogueText: "I assure you that I am."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It was a different circumstance, M..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was a different circumstance, Ms. Saltana. I plan to drive a much harder bargain today."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I would not call it an 'understand..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would not call it an 'understanding'. Wehlen is holding our land hostage."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Given the violent history of our r..."
entries.dialogueText: "Given the violent history of our region, any solution that doesn't involve bloodshed should be regarded as a success, wouldn't you say?"

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I'm prepared for that.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm prepared for that."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I understand. I feel the same abou..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand. I feel the same about my republic."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm sure they will. You are nowher..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure they will. You are nowhere near as noxious a negotiating partner as President Smolak."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I understand. I feel the same abou..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand. I feel the same about my republic."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, I'm sure you're disappointed..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, I'm sure you're disappointed that I didn't kowtow to your communist crony."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""We do share certain anti-imperiali..."
entries.dialogueText: "We do share certain anti-imperialist sentiments, but President Smolak is not my 'crony'."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""It's just a ceremony, Mr. Alvarez...."
entries.dialogueText: "It's just a ceremony, Mr. Alvarez. Don't read too much into it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I didn't say anything."
entries.dialogueText: I didn't say anything.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If the MITZ has truly had such a n..."
entries.dialogueText: "If the MITZ has truly had such a negative effect on Morella, why has no other leader before you brought this up?"

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""There is only one way forward. The..."
entries.dialogueText: "There is only one way forward. The MITZ must be restored to Morellan ownership."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I beg to differ, Ms. Saltana. Whet..."
entries.dialogueText: "I beg to differ, Ms. Saltana. Whether at home or abroad, the Kingdom of Rizia has always been committed to responsible mining practices."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is high time for us to revisit..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is high time for us to revisit the original agreement."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I am afraid my government will not..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am afraid my government will not be satisfied with cosmetic adjustments to the MITZ contract."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I appreciate the recent laws that..."
entries.dialogueText: "I appreciate the recent laws that you have passed in Rizia. However, they do not make up for the damage that has been done here."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I wish I could believe that. But y..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wish I could believe that. But your failure to pass even basic mining safety legislature in Rizia speaks volumes."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Morella's previous governments wer..."
entries.dialogueText: "Morella's previous governments were content to focus on the profits that could be squeezed out of the MITZ, not the consequences. But my coalition's rise to power shows how priorities have changed."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Alvarez audibly scoffed."
entries.dialogueText: Alvarez audibly scoffed.

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Is this actually what you believe,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Is this actually what you believe, *Miss* Saltana? Or are you just parroting the words of Chancellor Hegel?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Please calm down, Mr. Alvarez. You..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please calm down, Mr. Alvarez. You may disagree with the Morellan prime minister, but that doesn't give you an excuse to belittle her."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""You're right, of course. But my qu..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're right, of course. But my question still stands."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That isn't the way I would have ph..."
entries.dialogueText: "That isn't the way I would have phrased it, but I too have concerns about the growing closeness between Morella and the Republic of Valgsland."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Clearly it is the latter. Only a V..."
entries.dialogueText: "Clearly it is the latter. Only a Valgslandian socialist would believe nationalization is a better choice for Morella than a simple renegotiation of the MITZ contract."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I let Saltana respond."
entries.dialogueText: I let Saltana respond.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I assure you that my country's coo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I assure you that my country's cooperation with Valgsland is one based on mutual respect. There is no string-pulling."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""The current cooperation between Mo..."
entries.dialogueText: "The current cooperation between Morella and Valgsland is based on mutual respect. There is no string-pulling."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""All of us -- Morella included -- h..."
entries.dialogueText: "All of us -- Morella included -- have benefited from a contract that allows us to pay ITZ workers less, and grant them fewer protections, than in our individual home countries."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""At the same time, the area around..."
entries.dialogueText: "At the same time, the area around the Trade Zone has been turned into a dumping ground for toxic chemicals, to the detriment of our water systems and the people who depend on them."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I understand. I am not blind to Va..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand. I am not blind to Valgsland's role in increasing the sphere of influence of the Contanan Security Pact."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I understand that you are not happ..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand that you are not happy with Morella's new direction, Mr. Alvarez. But please don't discount my agency as prime minister."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""You may not be happy with Morella'..."
entries.dialogueText: "You may not be happy with Morella's new direction, {RiziaDLCText.SaltanaToPlayer}, But please don't discount my agency as prime minister."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That 'mutual respect' shouldn't im..."
entries.dialogueText: "That 'mutual respect' shouldn't impact the shared objectives of the Trade Zone. Every nation here should be treated with equal regard."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I've seen the way you two look at..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've seen the way you two look at each other. There's more than just 'mutual respect' going on there."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, Mr. Alvarez, not every intern..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, Mr. Alvarez, not every international relationship is as one-sided as that between Lespia and Pales."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Regardless, nationalization strike..."
entries.dialogueText: "Regardless, nationalization strikes me as a very extreme solution."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Lespian prime minister glowered..."
entries.dialogueText: The Lespian prime minister glowered at me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Saltana and Hegel's expressions tur..."
entries.dialogueText: Saltana and Hegel's expressions turned furious. Alvarez raised his eyebrows in amusement.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Such outright disrespect from More..."
entries.dialogueText: "Such outright disrespect from Morella's onetime ally is precisely why I favor nationalization."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What would it take for Rizia and M..."
entries.dialogueText: "What would it take for Rizia and Morella to achieve such a cooperation?"

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""If the nations of Rizia and Lespia..."
entries.dialogueText: "If the nations of Rizia and Lespia are willing to listen to my wishes, I have every intention of returning the favor."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""If your nation gives credence to m..."
entries.dialogueText: "If your nation gives credence to my wishes, I am more than willing to do the same."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I recognize that. But I am confide..."
entries.dialogueText: "I recognize that. But I am confident we can come up with a plan that satisfies the wishes of all four of our countries."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Hear, hear.""
entries.dialogueText: "Hear, hear."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Chancellor Hegel and I have begun..."
entries.dialogueText: "Chancellor Hegel and I have begun work on a proposal to transfer ownership of the MITZ to the Morellan state."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Should Rizia and Lespia choose to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Should Rizia and Lespia choose to buy shares, they could still continue operations in some capacity, albeit under strict oversight and with more input from workers."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That sounds like a fair enough dea..."
entries.dialogueText: "That sounds like a fair enough deal."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If it's oversight you want, our co..."
entries.dialogueText: "If it's oversight you want, our companies can implement that more efficiently without the interference of your government."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""'Some capacity'. How generous of y..."
entries.dialogueText: "'Some capacity'. How generous of you, Madam Prime Minister."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You must understand that I have Ri..."
entries.dialogueText: "You must understand that I have Rizia's own interests to think about. If I am to agree to such a proposal, I have to know that our economy will remain stable."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""It most certainly is not fair. Mad..."
entries.dialogueText: "It most certainly is not fair. Madam Prime Minister is ignoring the massive investments our countries have poured into the MITZ over the past decades."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Morella wouldn't have even been ab..."
entries.dialogueText: "Morella wouldn't have even been able to make a dent in the ground without Lespian technology. Now you want to cast us off like last season's furs?"

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""It *is* generous. This is Morella'..."
entries.dialogueText: "It *is* generous. This is Morella's own land, and Ms. Saltana may decide what to do with it."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""It may be Morella's land, but it's..."
entries.dialogueText: "It may be Morella's land, but it's only valuable because of our investments and technology."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""It is not my goal to bankrupt any..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is not my goal to bankrupt any of you. We're willing to make individual agreements with each stakeholder to offset any economic damage done by nationalization."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Saltana shook her head."
entries.dialogueText: Saltana shook her head.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Should we vote to proceed with a p..."
entries.dialogueText: "Should we vote to proceed with a proposal, I will solicit each of your input."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""The tragedy of the commons, {Rizia..."
entries.dialogueText: "The tragedy of the commons, {RiziaDLCText.SaltanaToPlayer}. As long as there are four nations trying to wring profit out of a limited resource, individual regulations will fail."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""The 'competition' that your capita..."
entries.dialogueText: "The 'competition' that your capitalist systems prize so dearly is but a race to the bottom that ignores both human rights and ecosystems."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Morella recognizes and appreciates..."
entries.dialogueText: "Morella recognizes and appreciates your contributions to the MITZ. Which is why your input would be solicited should we vote to proceed with nationalization."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""And if we vote *not* to proceed? W..."
entries.dialogueText: "And if we vote *not* to proceed? What then?"

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Then we will have to go back to th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then we will have to go back to the drawing board."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There is no innovation without com..."
entries.dialogueText: "There is no innovation without competition, Mr. Hegel. Where do you think Lespia's fancy mining equipment came from?"

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Morella wouldn't have even been ab..."
entries.dialogueText: "Morella wouldn't have even been able to make a dent in the ground without our technology. Now you want to cast us off like last season's furs?"

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Morella recognizes and appreciates..."
entries.dialogueText: "Morella recognizes and appreciates your contributions to the MITZ. Which is why your input would be solicited should we vote to proceed with nationalization."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Alvarez nodded."
entries.dialogueText: Alvarez nodded.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In the wrong hands, perhaps. But i..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the wrong hands, perhaps. But it doesn't need to be that way."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am not talking about competition..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am not talking about competition. I am talking about working together to build a more equitable ITZ."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""And what does the gentleman from L..."
entries.dialogueText: "And what does the gentleman from Lespia think of this idea?"

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""You are backing down too quickly,..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are backing down too quickly, Your Majesty. Competition is far preferable to the bureaucratic quagmire that is government oversight."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""I am open to any alternative that..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am open to any alternative that does not involve Morella obliterating the decades of investment we have poured into this region."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""And I for one will not allow Morel..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I for one will not allow Morella to obliterate the decades of investment Lespia has poured into this region."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""A valid question, Mr. Toras.""
entries.dialogueText: "A valid question, Mr. Toras."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Valgsland's socialist values indee..."
entries.dialogueText: "Valgsland's socialist values indeed took a backseat to economic stability in the early years of our republic."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""But more importantly, the prior le..."
entries.dialogueText: "But more importantly, the prior leaders of Morella could not be trusted to manage the MITZ with compassion and consideration. Giving away our stake then would have done more harm than good."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your government was promoting labo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your government was promoting labor union federations in Valgsland while underpaying miners here in the MITZ. If that isn't a betrayal of the cause, I don't know what is."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And you believe the current Morell..."
entries.dialogueText: "And you believe the current Morellan government is capable of such compassion?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You don't need to justify yourself..."
entries.dialogueText: "You don't need to justify yourself. Valgos invested heavily in the MITZ. There was no sense in throwing that money away."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""We were struggling to find our foo..."
entries.dialogueText: "We were struggling to find our footing after the independence of our colonies. Insisting on ideological purity would have destroyed the republic we were setting out to build."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""With all my heart.""
entries.dialogueText: "With all my heart."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""That was what my predecessor Wilhe..."
entries.dialogueText: "That was what my predecessor Wilhelm Ulbrik believed, yes."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His face darkened."
entries.dialogueText: His face darkened.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's very admirable of you, Mr...."
entries.dialogueText: "That's very admirable of you, Mr. Hegel. But Rizia was never a colonial empire. We have nothing to redeem ourselves for."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I still can't help but question th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I still can't help but question the motivations for your sudden show of generosity. What is Valgsland getting out of this?"

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""That's easy, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's easy, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Reparations are a positive step to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Reparations are a positive step towards addressing past wrongs. Perhaps this can serve as a model for the rest of us."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""The residents of the Arufelde rive..."
entries.dialogueText: "The residents of the Arufelde river system would say otherwise, Mr. Toras."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""A model for plunging this successf..."
entries.dialogueText: "A model for plunging this successful venture into ruin, you mean."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It does no one good to dwell on th..."
entries.dialogueText: "It does no one good to dwell on the past. We should be thinking about the future."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""I agree, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "I agree, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Please. The long-term benefits of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please. The long-term benefits of the MITZ to Morella far outweigh the handful of complaints about pollution."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""The Chancellor can dress up his ac..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Chancellor can dress up his actions however he pleases. But his support of Morella is nothing but a transparent attempt to regain Valgsland's foothold in South Merkopa."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Trouble in paradise?""
entries.dialogueText: "Trouble in paradise?"

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""But I now trust Ms. Saltana's coal..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I now trust Ms. Saltana's coalition to develop a system in which the miners themselves have a greater say in ITZ operations."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""I am prepared to help them develop..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am prepared to help them develop it myself, if necessary."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""'Compassion and consideration' are..."
entries.dialogueText: "'Compassion and consideration' are vague terms. How would you prefer the MITZ be run?"

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""I trust Ms. Saltana's coalition to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I trust Ms. Saltana's coalition to develop a system in which the miners themselves have a greater say in operations."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, I know what my decision is.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, I know what my decision is."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was my turn. Alvarez smiled as P..."
entries.dialogueText: It was my turn. Alvarez smiled as Prime Minister Saltana eyed me warily.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was my turn. Prime Minister Salt..."
entries.dialogueText: It was my turn. Prime Minister Saltana leaned forward eagerly as Alvarez eyed me warily.

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Good. Then let's proceed.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good. Then let's proceed."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Something like the Valgslandian la..."
entries.dialogueText: "Something like the Valgslandian labor union system, then?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hegel and Saltana looked at each ot..."
entries.dialogueText: Hegel and Saltana looked at each other.

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""I believe so. The successes of Val..."
entries.dialogueText: "I believe so. The successes of Valgslandian labor union federations in the agricultural and manufacturing industries speak for themselves."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""We will have to discuss that. Of c..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will have to discuss that. Of course unionization would be in the best interests of the workers, but we will need to maintain operational consistency. Especially at the beginning of the transition."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You have the right idea, Ms. Salta..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have the right idea, Ms. Saltana. All your efforts to make workers happy will be in vain if you don't have any money to pay them with."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No mixed messages, Ms. Saltana. Ei..."
entries.dialogueText: "No mixed messages, Ms. Saltana. Either you're on the side of the workers or you aren't."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""At the time, we were struggling to..."
entries.dialogueText: "At the time, we were struggling to find our footing after the independence of our colonies."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Thanks in part to our profits from..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks in part to our profits from the MITZ, we were able to pay reparations to our old territories. We must now do the same for the MITZ itself."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Not just Valgsland. The long arm o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not just Valgsland. The long arm of the CSP is involved in this."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""With all due respect to Ms. Saltan..."
entries.dialogueText: "With all due respect to Ms. Saltana, her government is completely unproven. I am wary of entrusting it with such a massive resource."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Precisely right, Your Majesty. The..."
entries.dialogueText: "Precisely right, Your Majesty. There's no reason to believe Morella can run the MITZ better than our corporations."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And what happens if Ms. Saltana's..."
entries.dialogueText: "And what happens if Ms. Saltana's government gets overthrown? Or corrupted?"

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Our dedication goes beyond any sin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our dedication goes beyond any single Morellan administration or leader. We will include provisions that safeguard our agreement in the case of such changes."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So am I.""
entries.dialogueText: "So am I."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Please, Your Majesty. This was nev..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please, Your Majesty. This was never about the workers."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""But that won't happen, will it? No..."
entries.dialogueText: "But that won't happen, will it? Not with Hegel by your side."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Countries can support one another..."
entries.dialogueText: "Countries can support one another for reasons beyond their own political or financial gain, you know."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Are you worried about losing your..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you worried about losing your grip on Pales? It's a little late for that."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""I certainly hope you're right abou..."
entries.dialogueText: "I certainly hope you're right about that."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Can they, Your Majesty? I wouldn't..."
entries.dialogueText: "Can they, Your Majesty? I wouldn't be so sure."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You must be worried about losing y..."
entries.dialogueText: "You must be worried about losing your grip on Pales."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Come on, Your Majesty. The presenc..."
entries.dialogueText: "Come on, Your Majesty. The presence of the CSP here in Morella bodes worse for you than it does for me."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""We are getting ahead of ourselves...."
entries.dialogueText: "We are getting ahead of ourselves. These details will be discussed once the nationalization plan is voted on."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Alvarez snickered."
entries.dialogueText: Alvarez snickered.

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""So Morella and Valgsland aren't su..."
entries.dialogueText: "So Morella and Valgsland aren't such a unified front after all."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Saltana motioned to her secretary t..."
entries.dialogueText: Saltana motioned to her secretary to take notes.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""We will use an open voting procedu..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will use an open voting procedure, going clockwise around the table."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""The Republic of Morella casts its..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Republic of Morella casts its vote in favor of nationalization."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""The Republic of Valgsland casts it..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Republic of Valgsland casts its vote for nationalization as well."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""The Prime Minister of Lespia, bein..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Prime Minister of Lespia, being of sound mind, casts his vote against nationalization."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let's talk about the river polluti..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's talk about the river pollution. I doubt the situation is as dire as you claim."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm sorry, Prime Minister Saltana,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry, Prime Minister Saltana, but I still don't see how the benefits of nationalization outweigh the drawbacks. Especially where Rizia is concerned."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I support your cause, Ms. Saltana,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I support your cause, Ms. Saltana, but the benefits of nationalization to Rizia are still unclear."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""If one only measures 'benefit' in..."
entries.dialogueText: "If one only measures 'benefit' in terms of profit, then yes, I admit our proposition is hardly advantageous."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Prime Minister Alvarez, if the nat..."
entries.dialogueText: "Prime Minister Alvarez, if the nationalization vote does not pass, would you still be willing to address the complaints Prime Minister Saltana has made?"

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""With that said, centralizing the M..."
entries.dialogueText: "With that said, centralizing the MITZ and restructuring its operations with a view towards sustainability will serve us all well in the long term."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""As will fostering goodwill between..."
entries.dialogueText: "As will fostering goodwill between the nations of Rizia and Morella."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I agree that a stronger bond betwe..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree that a stronger bond between our nations would be a benefit of its own."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""'Goodwill' is vague, Ms. Saltana...."
entries.dialogueText: "'Goodwill' is vague, Ms. Saltana. Are you talking about a trade agreement? A military alliance?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We are historical allies, Madam Pr..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are historical allies, Madam Prime Minister. There is already plenty of goodwill between us."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Morella remembers the aid we recei..."
entries.dialogueText: "Morella remembers the aid we received from Rizia in the days of the Moridian Empire. And vice versa, I'm sure."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""But it has been a century since th..."
entries.dialogueText: "But it has been a century since the revolution in our country. We must do more if we are to renew our bond."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I am open to discussion, {RiziaDLC..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am open to discussion, {RiziaDLCText.SaltanaToPlayer}".

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hegel looked disgruntled."
entries.dialogueText: Hegel looked disgruntled.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""We are historical allies. I see no..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are historical allies. I see no reason why we cannot renew our bond."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Fostering goodwill is not necessar..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fostering goodwill is not necessary. A more sustainable ITZ is indeed its own reward."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Indeed it is, Mr. Toras.""
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed it is, Mr. Toras."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Morella is only now embracing its..."
entries.dialogueText: "Morella is only now embracing its full potential, Ms. Saltana. Saddling yourself to a monarchy will only make you weaker."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Rizia has treated us with respect..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia has treated us with respect thus far. I owe King Romus the same."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""It's true that King Romus has not..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's true that King Romus has not given us any reason to trust him thus far. But if he votes for nationalization, I would give him the benefit of the doubt."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""You are mistaken, {RiziaDLCText.Sa..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are mistaken, {RiziaDLCText.SaltanaToPlayer}."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""At the beginning of ITZ operations..."
entries.dialogueText: "At the beginning of ITZ operations, companies like your Rizian Royal Gold were allowing their wastewater to drain directly into the Arufelde River."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Techniques have been refined since..."
entries.dialogueText: "Techniques have been refined since then, but the damage has lingered."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""We both know that's wishful thinki..."
entries.dialogueText: "We both know that's wishful thinking."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Our nationalization plan would not..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our nationalization plan would not only mandate stricter environmental oversight of the mines, it would allocate a portion of revenue to cleaning up the river and aiding the affected communities."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Given the level of respect with wh..."
entries.dialogueText: "Given the level of respect with which Rizia has treated us thus far, I do see potential for cooperation as well."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Given the rather stark differences..."
entries.dialogueText: "Given the rather stark differences between our countries, you may be right."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Wouldn't it be more efficient if t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wouldn't it be more efficient if the MITZ stakeholders took charge of such efforts themselves?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It'll be difficult to undertake su..."
entries.dialogueText: "It'll be difficult to undertake such a huge environmental effort *and* institute fair pay for workers."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's encouraging to hear. I look..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's encouraging to hear. I look forward to discussing the specifics."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""It's a challenge, but one we're pr..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's a challenge, but one we're prepared to face. Ideally with the help of our international partners."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Apologies, {RiziaDLCText.SaltanaTo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Apologies, {RiziaDLCText.SaltanaToPlayer}, but I don't trust your nation or any other to know what's best for Morella and its people."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""We'll have a more indepth discussi..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll have a more indepth discussion soon after the vote has concluded."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hegel was still seated. I could fee..."
entries.dialogueText: Hegel was still seated. I could feel his eyes boring into me.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I smiled at him."
entries.dialogueText: I smiled at him.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hope you're satisfied.""
entries.dialogueText: "I hope you're satisfied."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sorry, Chancellor. Your gambit did..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry, Chancellor. Your gambit didn't work."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I made no acknowledgement of the Va..."
entries.dialogueText: I made no acknowledgement of the Valgslandian chancellor as I left the room.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He gave me the same mysterious smil..."
entries.dialogueText: He gave me the same mysterious smile as he had before.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He smiled back, looking genuinely p..."
entries.dialogueText: He smiled back, looking genuinely pleased.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His expression remained the same."
entries.dialogueText: His expression remained the same.

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""I will be satisfied when I see a d..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will be satisfied when I see a draft."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""That you still think of it as 'my..."
entries.dialogueText: "That you still think of it as 'my gambit' proves your utter disregard for your neighbor."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Would you like to say something to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Would you like to say something to me?"

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""No, Mr. Toras. Your vote has said..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, Mr. Toras. Your vote has said it all."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Not now, Mr. Toras. But soon.""
entries.dialogueText: "Not now, Mr. Toras. But soon."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We walked back onto the stage of th..."
entries.dialogueText: We walked back onto the stage of the reception hall and awaited Prime Minister Saltana's announcement.

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""A brave choice, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "A brave choice, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Very good, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Very good, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Voting against nationalization whi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Voting against nationalization while not completely dismissing Morella's concerns was the safest choice."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Rusty will certainly be pleased wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rusty will certainly be pleased with that stance, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""I do fear it will be hard to keep..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do fear it will be hard to keep the status quo in the MITZ without Lespia's close cooperation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That won't be an issue. Alvarez an..."
entries.dialogueText: "That won't be an issue. Alvarez and I are completely simpatico."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Not surprised. Disappointed.""
entries.dialogueText: "Not surprised. Disappointed."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""It was an unpleasant surprise, I'l..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was an unpleasant surprise, I'll tell you that."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""For now. Don't forget I have frien..."
entries.dialogueText: "For now. Don't forget I have friends in high places."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""First your naval shenanigans with..."
entries.dialogueText: "First your naval shenanigans with Pales, now this..."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""First your underhanded dealings wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "First your underhanded dealings with Pales, now this..."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""First you refuse my gas deal, now..."
entries.dialogueText: "First you refuse my gas deal, now this..."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""You're really starting to test my..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're really starting to test my resolve, King Toras."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""If not for your generosity with th..."
entries.dialogueText: "If not for your generosity with the Pales gas field, you would really be starting to test my resolve."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""This almost makes up for your nava..."
entries.dialogueText: "This almost makes up for your naval shenanigans in Pales. Almost."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""This almost makes up for your unde..."
entries.dialogueText: "This almost makes up for your underhanded dealings with Pales. Almost."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""This almost makes up for your refu..."
entries.dialogueText: "This almost makes up for your refusal of my gas deal. Almost."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Between this and your handling of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Between this and your handling of the Pales gas field situation, I'm almost starting to like you. Almost."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't need Lespia's cooperation...."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't need Lespia's cooperation. I'm going to make sure Alvarez gets left with nothing."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""We'll have to drive a hard bargain..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll have to drive a hard bargain with Morella or risk disrupting gold production."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This isn't about gold production...."
entries.dialogueText: "This isn't about gold production. It's about doing what's right."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The important thing is that we get..."
entries.dialogueText: "The important thing is that we get to screw over Lespia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know. But I truly think this wil..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know. But I truly think this will be better for us in the long run."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If we can use this to get closer t..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we can use this to get closer to Morella, the lost profits will be worth it."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""I see. Then we certainly do have o..."
entries.dialogueText: "I see. Then we certainly do have our work cut out for us."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""You may be right about that.""
entries.dialogueText: "You may be right about that."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""You're the king. I trust your inst..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're the king. I trust your instincts."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Noble thoughts from a noble man.""
entries.dialogueText: "Noble thoughts from a noble man."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""He may be planning the same for us.""
entries.dialogueText: "He may be planning the same for us."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""I hope he feels the same way.""
entries.dialogueText: "I hope he feels the same way."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I can spot the cracks between More..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can spot the cracks between Morella and Valgsland. It won't be hard to break up their front."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Risky. But perhaps worth it.""
entries.dialogueText: "Risky. But perhaps worth it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This isn't about making the safest..."
entries.dialogueText: "This isn't about making the safest choice. It's about doing what's right."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Noble thoughts from a noble man.""
entries.dialogueText: "Noble thoughts from a noble man."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't mind some gentlemanly nego..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't mind some gentlemanly negotiations. We can afford it."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Well, don't go too overboard with..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, don't go too overboard with your promises."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Clever, wasn't it? Not that I actu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Clever, wasn't it? Not that I actually intend to give Ms. Saltana what she wants."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Clever indeed.""
entries.dialogueText: "Clever indeed."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""The assets currently owned by Valg..."
entries.dialogueText: "The assets currently owned by Valgsland, Rizia and Lespia would be purchased by a new Morella-owned company formed specifically for the governance of the MITZ. Each country would then have the opportunity to buy shares in that company."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""The Republic of Valgsland has alre..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Republic of Valgsland has already agreed to forego that opportunity."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Saltana nodded."
entries.dialogueText: Saltana nodded.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Nationalization doesn't seem reaso..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nationalization doesn't seem reasonable to me. What's your opinion?"

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""The nationalization agreement does..."
entries.dialogueText: "The nationalization agreement doesn't seem beneficial on the surface. But I can see a few possible perks."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""I'm not saying I support this plan..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not saying I support this plan. Only that it need not be a disaster for us."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Even if Rizia buys back its former..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even if Rizia buys back its former share of the MITZ, Morella's planned regulations will limit the revenue we can earn from it."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Elena. How could you?""
entries.dialogueText: "Elena. How could you?"

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Any nationalization plan will stil..."
entries.dialogueText: "Any nationalization plan will still need Rizia's support to go through."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""That means we'll be in a position..."
entries.dialogueText: "That means we'll be in a position to make demands. What we lose in gold, we could gain by making a good energy deal, for example."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""An energy deal would be a better l..."
entries.dialogueText: "An energy deal would be a better long-term solution than relying on gold mining in a foreign country, anyway."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Huh. Sounds like I've got my money..."
entries.dialogueText: "Huh. Sounds like I've got my money on the wrong resource."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Or military assistance?""
entries.dialogueText: "Or military assistance?"

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Maybe. Although I'd imagine their..."
entries.dialogueText: "Maybe. Although I'd imagine their losses in the War of Rizian Succession would make Morella shy in that arena."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No. Rizia is and will always be th..."
entries.dialogueText: "No. Rizia is and will always be the country with the gold."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's mostly my money, not yours.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's mostly my money, not yours."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm sure we can work something out..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure we can work something out, Rusty."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""As long as we have energy to offer..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as we have energy to offer, that is."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""There's one other possibility...""
entries.dialogueText: "There's one other possibility..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She lowered her voice."
entries.dialogueText: She lowered her voice.

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""We not only buy back Rizia's share..."
entries.dialogueText: "We not only buy back Rizia's share of the MITZ, we purchase Lespia's out from under them."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rusty grinned."
entries.dialogueText: Rusty grinned.

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""*That* is a plan I can get behind.""
entries.dialogueText: "*That* is a plan I can get behind."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Push Lespia out of the MITZ and in..."
entries.dialogueText: "Push Lespia out of the MITZ and increase our gold returns while we're at it? Great idea."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Interesting. But I don't know if i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Interesting. But I don't know if it'll be worth the short-term hit to our finances."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Voting yes on nationalization woul..."
entries.dialogueText: "Voting yes on nationalization would already hurt relations with Lespia. I don't want to make things even worse."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""It's just a thought, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's just a thought, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Thank you, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Look at those two. As cozy as peas..."
entries.dialogueText: "Look at those two. As cozy as peas in a pod."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""United against capitalist greed. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "United against capitalist greed. It's stirring, really."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As long as Rizia and Lespia put up..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as Rizia and Lespia put up a united front, we've got nothing to worry about."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Reminds me of you and a certain Du..."
entries.dialogueText: "Reminds me of you and a certain Duke of Pales."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I didn't acknowledge his remark."
entries.dialogueText: I didn't acknowledge his remark.

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""They're not your friends, you know..."
entries.dialogueText: "They're not your friends, you know. They're out to bleed both of us dry."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He gave me an incredulous look and..."
entries.dialogueText: He gave me an incredulous look and turned back towards the cameras.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You may kiss me if you like, Mr. P..."
entries.dialogueText: "You may kiss me if you like, Mr. Prime Minister."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't worry. I won't let them.""
entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry. I won't let them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Have you ever considered that we m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Have you ever considered that we might deserve it?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have faith that we can give More..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have faith that we can give Morella its due without our economies coming to ruin."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He gave a curt nod before turning b..."
entries.dialogueText: He gave a curt nod before turning back towards the cameras.

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
Paskal Beniwoll
Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Prime Minister Saltana brought up..."
entries.dialogueText: "Prime Minister Saltana brought up some very valid points. I need to think this over carefully."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Think about it. If it hadn't been..."
entries.dialogueText: "Think about it. If it hadn't been for the MITZ's cheap resources, the Rizian economy never would've recovered from 1926. And then who knows how long the monarchy's great comeback would've lasted?"
